translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of bruises, sprains, low back pain, stiff shoulders, muscle pain, and joint pain.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner from the medicated surface and apply the patch to the affected area 1 to 3 times a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: infants under 30 months of age; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine or to cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; children; women who are pregnant or may be pregnant; breastfeeding women. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. Do not warm the affected area with a heater, an electric blanket or the like. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness (congestion and reddening); itching; swelling. If severe itching or pain occasionally occurs, stop using it. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
